clue.text: Making Mark proud of himself, impressing duke with drink

indicators.note: to impress is to press into, so the duke and the drink are pushed inside the word for self-satisfied

parts.note: smug means self-satisfied, proud of oneself
gin is a spirit, a drink

explanation.surface: A conceited man named Mark is having a drink with a duke.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital on 'Mark' disguises it: the definition is 'Making mark', to smear or blot.
explanation.definitionFit: Smearing a surface so it is left blotted or stained is making a mark on it.

clue.text: Miserly old city council imported construction kit

indicators.note: brought in, so the council's letters are carried inside the word for stingy

parts.note: mean means stingy, miserly
CC is the abbreviation for city council

explanation.surface: A stingy local authority brought in a toy building set.
explanation.definitionFit: The trade name of a long-running metal toy set of strips, nuts and bolts for building models.

clue.text: Frank girl coming out with appeal for regular transfer

parts.note: frank means straightforward, plain-speaking
a deb (debutante) is a young woman making her coming-out into society
IT is sex appeal, as in the 'It girl'

explanation.surface: An outspoken debutante, full of charm, sets up a recurring payment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming out' here is a debutante's formal entry into society.
explanation.definitionFit: A standing bank instruction letting a company take payments from an account on a regular schedule.

clue.text: Chic clique that often appears in magazine

parts.note: in means fashionable, chic
a set is a social group or clique

explanation.surface: A fashionable crowd regularly features in glossy magazines.
explanation.definitionFit: A small picture or map placed within a larger page is a common layout feature of printed periodicals.

clue.text: Service head devouring new Greek character's food

indicators.note: eating up, so the officer's letters swallow the letter for new

parts.note: GOC is General Officer Commanding, the head of an army command
chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A military commander is wolfing down a new Greek's meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Small Italian potato dumplings are a dish, so they count as food.

clue.text: Rubbish musical about Heart of Midlothian

indicators.note: goes around, so the show's title is wrapped round the central letters

parts.note: Hair is the 1960s rock musical

indicators.note: the heart is the middle, the two central letters of Midlothian

explanation.surface: A sneering verdict on a show about Edinburgh's football club, Heart of Midlothian.
explanation.walkthrough: Heart of Midlothian is a Scottish football club; here 'Heart of' just takes the middle letters OT.
explanation.definitionFit: Empty boastful talk is nonsense, so it is a slang term for rubbish.

clue.text: Backer mostly into monster plot feature

indicators.note: placed inside, so the shortened sponsor goes into the monster's name

parts.note: the Hydra is the many-headed monster of Greek myth

indicators.note: most of the word, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: an angel is a financial backer, especially of a theatre show

explanation.surface: A sponsor gets involved in a monstrous storyline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' tempts as a story, but it is a garden plot. ANGEL less its L gives ANGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A flowering shrub with large round heads of blooms, a typical feature of a garden bed.

clue.text: Get brown belt

definitions.meaning: to go brown in the sun
to belt is to thrash or leather someone

explanation.surface: Earn a brown belt in a martial art.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to darken the skin in sunlight and, informally, to beat or thrash.

clue.text: After brief verbal abuse, a caller finally gets cut off

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: an insult is a piece of verbal abuse

indicators.note: takes only the last letter of caller

explanation.surface: A phone caller who hears abuse ends up being cut off mid-call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut off' looks like the call being ended, but it is the definition: isolated.
explanation.definitionFit: Island-like and isolated, inward-looking and detached from the wider world.

clue.text: Journos get shot of Republican parties in affair

indicators.note: get rid of, so the Republican's letter is removed

parts.note: journalists, reporters who file stories

explanation.surface: Reporters ditch a Republican for being embroiled in a scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Affair' sounds political, but it is adultery: the parties are those named in a divorce alongside the spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: In a divorce for adultery, the people cited as having had the extramarital relationship with the spouse.

clue.text: Window that opens in theatre

definitions.meaning: a tall narrow pointed-arch window in Gothic buildings
a surgeon's small two-edged knife, used to open incisions in an operating theatre

explanation.surface: A window that opens onto a stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Theatre' looks like a playhouse, but it is an operating theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a narrow pointed Gothic window and a small sharp surgical blade.

clue.text: Leggy bird, alert, finding similar prey?

parts.note: a crane is a long-legged wading bird
fly is slang for sharp, quick-witted

explanation.surface: A long-legged bird, on watch, spots something to eat that looks like itself.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the wordplay: the insect is long-legged like the bird and is the sort of thing birds eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The daddy-long-legs is a gangly-limbed insect, so it resembles a long-legged bird and is eaten by birds.

clue.text: Ring gong in cleaner, sound lab

parts.note: to ring is to resound, reverberate

indicators.note: placed inside, so the medal goes within the cleaner

parts.note: a char is a cleaning lady
a gong is slang for a medal or honour, such as the MBE (Member of the Order of the British Empire)

explanation.surface: Phoning a gong-wearing cleaner at the acoustics laboratory.
explanation.walkthrough: A char (charwoman) is a British cleaner; a 'gong' is slang for a decoration such as the MBE.
explanation.definitionFit: A room with hard reflective walls used to create reverberation for recordings is a kind of acoustics laboratory.

clue.text: Fool mending faulty carpeting

parts.note: to con is to fool or trick

indicators.note: out of order, so the letters of mending are rearranged

explanation.surface: An idiot doing a botched repair job on the carpet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carpeting' as floor covering is the trap: it is a telling-off, as in 'carpeted by the boss'.
explanation.definitionFit: To carpet someone is to reprimand them, so carpeting is severely criticising or censuring.

clue.text: It's normal getting thrown out for the likes of adultery

indicators.note: thrown into disorder, so the letters of the two words are scrambled

explanation.surface: Infidelity is commonplace these days, with people getting thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: Adultery is one of the grave wrongs that, in Catholic teaching, cut the soul off from grace.

clue.text: Launch hotel address online

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a URL is a web address

explanation.surface: Launching a hotel's website.
explanation.definitionFit: To launch something is to throw it with force, fling it.

clue.text: Beat team driver for one

definitions.meaning: to bludgeon with a heavy stick
a sports side, such as a football side
a driver is one kind of golf stick

explanation.surface: A squad defeated by the team's chauffeur.
explanation.walkthrough: Three definitions: 'driver' is a golf stick, not a motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to strike with a cudgel, a sports team, and an implement for hitting golf balls, of which a driver is one.

clue.text: Cash in Europe guaranteed time off

parts.note: the lei are the currency units of Romania
sure means certain, guaranteed

explanation.surface: Money while on the Continent is assured during a holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Free hours away from work, spare hours for recreation.

clue.text: Investigator dealing with Home Counties radio serial briefly

parts.note: re means concerning, dealing with
the Home Counties around London lie in the South East, SE

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: The Archers is the long-running BBC radio soap opera

explanation.surface: A detective looking into a radio soap set near London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties around London in south-east England; The Archers is a BBC radio rural soap.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who studies a subject in depth to discover facts is an investigator.

clue.text: Endure nasty virus very close to home

indicators.note: nasty suggests something mangled, so the letters of virus are rearranged
the close, or end, of the word home, its last letter

explanation.surface: Coping with a bad bug spreading close to home.
explanation.definitionFit: To last through hardship and come out alive is to endure it.

clue.text: E for expert?

parts.note: the first letter, or head, of the word egg is E

explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as instructions: the head of 'egg' is the letter E. The question mark marks the indirect definition, an intellectual.
explanation.definitionFit: A highbrow intellectual, often a quiz specialist, is informally called an expert or boffin.

clue.text: A trio made a mess of broadcast between planes

indicators.note: mangled, so the letters of a trio are jumbled

parts.note: to air is to broadcast

explanation.surface: Three performers botched a broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Describing missiles or communication passing from one aircraft to another in flight.

clue.text: Daily, say, sent back fee

parts.note: a daily is a British cleaning lady, a char

indicators.note: returned, so the abbreviation is written backwards

parts.note: eg (for example) means say

explanation.surface: A newspaper returns a fee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daily' looks like a newspaper; in Britain a daily is also a cleaner who comes in each day.
explanation.definitionFit: A price asked for a service is a fee.

clue.text: Kid scolded once, having crossed line

indicators.note: the line is crossed by, so sits inside, the old verb form

parts.note: chid is the old past tense of chide, to scold

explanation.surface: A child once told off for stepping over a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A kid is informal for a young person, a youngster.

clue.text: Blue Berets merited one story paper put in without reason

parts.note: UN peacekeepers wear blue berets
just means deserved, merited
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: inserted, so the newspaper goes inside the tale

parts.note: a fable is a story
the i is a British national newspaper

explanation.surface: Peacekeepers deserved one newspaper story, published.
explanation.walkthrough: The i is a British daily paper. Blue Berets are United Nations troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that cannot be defended or excused has no valid grounds, so it is without reason.

clue.text: What Rose may do, or cat? Not half!

indicators.note: only half the word is kept, its first three letters

parts.note: a jaguar is a big cat

explanation.surface: What might a woman called Rose do, or her cat? Plenty!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rose' looks like a woman's name but is the flower, whose thorns prick. 'Not half!' is also British slang for 'very much'.
explanation.definitionFit: To jab or prick, as a thorny rose bush does to the hand.

clue.text: North Sea port offering little work during peak

indicators.note: within, so the unit of work is set inside the mountain

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain peak, as in Ben Nevis
an erg is a tiny unit of work in physics

explanation.surface: A port offering a short job while at the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: A Norwegian city on the west coast, a harbour facing the North Sea.

clue.text: What invading Spaniards sought in field or a domain

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words field or a domain

explanation.surface: What the conquistadors were after in some field or territory.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary city of gold that the conquistadors hunted for in South America.
